content: The real question is not whether life exists after death. The real question is whether you are alive before death.
author: Osho
sourceWork: Courage: The Joy of Living Dangerously
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. Reminding yourself of your mortality is not morbid; it is the most clarifying lens available to human consciousness. When you remember that your days are strictly numbered, petty resentments and trivial anxieties evaporate.

Across his life and work, Osho saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. Death gives urgency and sweetness to every ordinary afternoon. Because this day will never come again, the way you spend your attention right now is of monumental significance.
reflectionPrompt: What long-held assumption about your life or abilities is challenged by this insight?
